name: rulebook
description: No-code builder for wallet-owned, self-funded on-chain automations.

scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run build -w backend" "npm run build -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "shared,backend,frontend" "npm run typecheck -w packages/shared" "npm run typecheck -w backend" "npm run typecheck -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "shared,backend,frontend" "npm run test -w packages/shared" "npm run test -w backend" "npm run test -w frontend"
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w backend
